notes_for_editor: Only the 2016 list names this tower. Its 'datasheet' tag has no survey ID, so the NGS record it points to was not located; if a Vidette station with a PID turns up, its description may say whether a tower stood there, as the Vaughn datasheet does. The list point lies about 8 km (5 mi) east of the Wikipedia city coordinates (our calculation). The USGS GNIS gazetteer places the populated place Vidette at about 33.03765, -82.24735; that bulk file cannot be quote-checked, so it is not cited. The elevation 331 is assumed to be feet (see the Van Creek notes). No source gives a build date, staffing, fate, or current access.
